summary: Coordinated and integrated the console's learning-first rebuild across twelve delegated writers, and built the foundation they worked to: the four-altitude page template (docs/agents/approach-page-template.md), the record-rendering components (web/components/Research.tsx: EvidenceLabel, TechnicalDetails, and sentence-form Theory/Experiment/Result summaries built only from record fields), the /theories/[id] and /experiments/[id] detail routes with plain-English overlays from web/content/research/, the interactive look-ahead TreeExplorer, the records-based draft generator, and two checkers (web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs, check-routes.sh). Wrote the four original concept pages and the glossary, and corrected them where writers found them contradicted by the records: the sibling-trap page had repeated status.md's claim that the afterstate line has no implementation (four pilot results exist), the compute page omitted finding-05's replicated +101,171-point seven-strata result and its depth interaction, and the rules page stated the original game's reveal timing as though it were this engine's (audit-01 M2). Amended theory TH-20260821-search-guided-self-play-at-scale-299ed02f so its mechanism reflects the afterstate pilot rather than overstating that every learned evaluator failed on data shape. Consolidated 30+ inter-document discrepancies the writers surfaced into docs/exploratory/record-consistency-notes.md without editing any record.
